<section class="slide color-box color-box--" id="area-highlights-0">
<div class="container">
<div class="slide__heading">
<h1 class="font-special slide__title">South Tyrol – The other side of Italy</h1>
<div><p style="text-align:left">Italy’s northernmost province combines Alpine staidness with Italian joie-de-vivre, the Dolomites – a UNESCO World Heritage site – and cultural diversity. South Tyrol is a region abounding with contrasts, between Mediterranean landscape and Alpine peaks, deeply rooted tradition and cosmopolitan curiosity. The allure of South Tyrol lies in its variety and the harmony of opposites.</p>
</div>
</div>
